Q1: I usually write at the coffee shop. What about you?
A: Hi! I usually write at home because I don't like crowded places. I think it helps me concentrate better because there is less noise and fewer people around me. As a result, I can focus more easily on what I am doing and feel more comfortable.

A: Personally, I stay updated on international events by reading trustworthy online newspapers every morning. I also listen to expert podcasts during my daily commute, which provides deep insights and helps me verify facts from multiple perspectives.
